requests.prompt: Rework this transparent init silhouette into ONE CONTINUOUS rocky mountain range for a classic 1990s fantasy adventure map. Keep the exact native 256 by 160 transparent canvas and the broad eight-tile-wide joined footprint. CAMERA: south of the range looking north from about 45 degrees above the terrain, neither front elevation nor overhead. Show the south-facing rock wall plus partial east and west side planes; hide the northern slopes behind the crest. STRUCTURE: fuse every peak into uninterrupted saddles, ridgelines, foothills, and a broad continuous foreground stone mass. Remove the repeated-source look. There must be no transparent channel, grass corridor, or valley cutting through the interior. Keep irregular unequal peaks and low broad overlap-friendly shoulders at both ends. LIGHT: sun from southeast at map lower-right; east and southeast planes warm light grey, western and left-facing slopes deep cool charcoal shadow, shadows falling northwest/upper-left. Slate-grey and warm-grey rock, dark fissures, extremely sparse muted olive lichen only in cracks. Deliberate hand-pixelled Heroes II-era storybook sprite, no scenery plate, transparent outside the rock silhouette.
